test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

Choosing the right software for any purpose can be a/an ________ task for any business.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e**. 'Challenging'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** most appropriate** word to fill in the blank is **"challenging".**
 
• **"Challenging" **means demanding or testing the abilities of (someone or something).
 
• **In this context, **choosing the right software indeed could be a complex and demanding task.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Choosing the right software for any purpose can be a **challenging** task for any business.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, explaining the other options:
 
 
• **Intimating-** This means to imply or make known indirectly. It **does not fit** in this context. You wouldn't describe a task as "intimating."
 
• **Flickering -** This means to shine with a light that is not steady; twinkle. Typically used to describe light,** it does not make sense** to describe a task as "flickering."
 
• **Attributing - **This means to regard something as being caused by or belonging to. In this context,** the word "attributing" does not make sense**, because it does not correctly describe a characteristic of a task.
